title: Define the facility temporal, status and publication-state model
requirements:
- Describe the CGR as a potential cross-sector capability, with an interim path where none exists
- Separate legal, operational, accreditation and service-availability status with controlled values and effective periods
- Define states and their criteria; represent status and effective periods
- Require persistent area identifiers, effective periods and versioned boundaries for historical reporting
- Allow provisional facility records followed by time-bound completion
- Ensure historical queries reproduce facility state at a date
- Use explicit normative language for CGR integration and treat temporal/notification services as target capabilities
- Define permitted transitions, authority, propagation and audit
